envelope.description: Scaffold the deploy-step phase handlers with one representative narrow-emit path

body.title: Scaffold the deploy-step phase handlers with one representative narrow-emit path
body.summary: Create src/mcp/deploy-step/phases/ with the phase-handler scaffolding and one fully-wired representative phase path that issues its prompt+schema and registers into the dispatch table via DeployStageRegistrar.register(). Per-stage runner bodies (discover/reuse/topology/security/scale) are deferred to s2–s6; s1 proves the loop skeleton and the emit_bundle → DeploymentContextBundle output contract on the representative path only.
acceptanceChecks: src/mcp/deploy-step/phases/ contains a representative phase handler that returns prompt + JSON schema for its emit step and, on emit_bundle, produces a well-formed DeploymentContextBundle quartet (never a raw file dump).
The representative handler registers itself into the dispatch table through a DeployStageRegistrar.register() implementation so handleDeployStep can route its phase.

An empty deployment surface yields a well-formed bundle with empty entities/relations/citations and an explanatory summary (valid result, not an error); a large entity set stays a structured quartet and is never downgraded to a raw dump.
Bundle entity/citation paths are graph-sourced DeploymentEntityRef values (SHA256 entityId, non-hallucinated path), not free-text file references.

tests.name: src/mcp/deploy-step/__tests__/deploy-step-narrow.test.ts › the representative phase handler issues its emit prompt + JSON schema and registers itself into the dispatch table via DeployStageRegistrar.register()

src/mcp/deploy-step/__tests__/deploy-step-bundle.test.ts › the representative stage emits a graph-grounded DeploymentContextBundle quartet with SHA256 entityId / non-hallucinated paths (never a raw dump), and the empty-surface and very-large-surface fixtures both stay well-formed quartets
